reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable applicants to submit an AUU application with real-time field validation and display mandatory declarations and error messages for missing or invalid inputs.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable customers to view product origin details, quality certifications, and availability status on product pages.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 contributes the capability to allow customers to access and view product origin details, including quality certifications and availability status, which collectively define the complete scope of this high-level goal.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable customers to submit, modify, confirm, and receive notifications for order changes due to insufficient availability, while ensuring all orders meet minimum quantity requirements.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 enables customers to submit orders with minimum quantity constraints; llg_002 allows modification of existing orders by altering quantities or items; llg_003 triggers confirmation and system validation; llg_004 introduces a distinct capability to notify customers of availability-driven changes and provide API-based acceptance/rejection, which is materially different from the other goals and must be explicitly included.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable customers to monitor wallet balances, receive payment notifications, manage insufficient funds with grace periods, recharge wallets via in-store terminals or online transfers, and process partial payments for orders.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 enables customers to check wallet balance and payment status, which supports awareness of fund availability. llg_002 enables real-time payment notifications, enhancing transparency. llg_003 introduces a grace period for insufficient balance, allowing customers to avoid immediate order cancellation. llg_004 enables in-store wallet recharging, supporting physical transaction channels. llg_005 enables online wallet recharging, supporting digital transaction channels. llg_006 introduces partial payment support, enabling installment or partial order payments — a distinct capability not covered by the others.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable customers to schedule, be reminded of, and be notified about missed pickup events for product pickup at stores, including enforcement of forfeit policies upon missed pickups.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 enables the customer to select a pickup time slot based on store availability; llg_002 ensures the customer receives a reminder notification before the pickup time to confirm attendance; llg_003 ensures the customer is notified if they miss their pickup time and is informed of the forfeit policy consequences — which introduces an unrelated or broader capability (enforcement of policy consequences) that must be explicitly included to expose the mismatch.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable farmers to submit, update, and confirm product availability estimates for dynamic allocation and order fulfillment, with real-time updates and a Monday-morning confirmation deadline.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 enables initial submission of product availability estimates for dynamic allocation; llg_002 adds real-time update capability via API to reflect stock or delivery changes; llg_003 introduces a mandatory Monday-morning confirmation of final quantities available for order, which is a distinct lifecycle phase and deadline not covered by the other goals.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Implement a dynamic customer prioritization system during shortages that calculates, updates, and displays a fair-play score to determine order priority and enable customer self-service visibility.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to automatically prioritize customer orders during shortages using a fair-play score. llg_002 adds the capability for customers to view their fair-play score to understand their priority level. llg_003 adds the capability to calculate and update the fair-play score based on completed orders, reminders, or penalties via API. Together, these form a complete system that dynamically prioritizes customers during shortages, updates scores via API, and provides customer-facing visibility — with no inferred or omitted functionality.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable store employees to manage end-to-end order fulfillment, including coordination of product pickup, processing customer payments, and confirming delivery status to update system records.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 enables store employees to view and manage pending orders for fulfillment; llg_002 adds the capability to coordinate pickup logistics including time and location; llg_003 introduces payment processing and wallet balance updates via system API; llg_004 adds the capability to confirm delivery status and update system records. Together, these form a complete end-to-end order fulfillment workflow with distinct lifecycle phases: order management, pickup coordination, payment processing, and delivery confirmation.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Automatically notify farmers and customers of delivery delays, cancel late orders, credit back missing amounts with a 20% bonus, and provide estimated resolution times via API.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 adds notification to farmers and automatic 20% bonus credit on delays; llg_002 adds notification to customers and estimated resolution time; llg_003 adds automatic 20% bonus credit for missing amounts; llg_004 adds order cancellation and 20% bonus credit for late deliveries — all via API, with no overlap or omission.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Record and enforce transactional obligations including payment and pickup forfeit policies via API-driven enforcement mechanisms.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to record transaction details and enforce payment rules via API. llg_002 adds the capability to enforce a pickup forfeit policy, deducting from wallet or marking as forfeited via API. Together, they define a system that enforces financial obligations tied to transactional events — specifically payments and pickup-related forfeits — with API-based enforcement as the common mechanism.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable event organizers to create event details and invite guests using unique invitation codes.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 enables the creation and configuration of event details including name, date, location, and budget, while llg_002 enables the generation and distribution of unique invitation codes to guests via email or messaging. These are distinct, materially different capabilities: one involves event metadata setup, the other involves guest access control via invitation codes. No broader or unrelated capability is introduced, and no functionality is inferred beyond these two.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable event organizers to browse, filter, select, and book event services based on category, price, and availability.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 contributes the capability to browse and select event services by filtering on category, price, and availability, and to initiate booking. No other LLGs are provided, so the reconstructed goal encompasses only this single capability without adding or omitting any detail.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Book selected services with payment options including one-time, installment, or on-site payment methods, and confirm the booking for the event organizer.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 specifies the capability to book selected services and select payment methods (one-time, installment, on-site), which fully defines the scope. No other LLGs are provided, so the reconstructed goal must include only this capability without adding or omitting anything.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable service providers to publish, categorize, and tag their service offerings on the platform for discoverability by event organizers.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 enables service providers to publish service offerings by uploading details such as description, pricing, and availability; llg_002 enables them to categorize and tag services to enhance discoverability by event organizers. Together, these capabilities form a complete scope for service publication and metadata management, with no unrelated or broader capabilities introduced.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Provide a complete service lifecycle for event organizers, including responding to appointment requests, generating and sending quotations, and confirming payment receipt for completed services.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to respond to appointment requests by accepting or declining them via the platform. llg_002 adds the capability to generate and send quotations with pricing and terms to event organizers. llg_003 adds the capability to confirm payment receipt after service completion, marking the service as done. These three distinct lifecycle phases — request handling, quotation generation, and payment confirmation — are all required and must be preserved as separate functional capabilities in the reconstructed goal.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable invited guests to securely access and view event-related content, including blogs and photos, by authenticating via an invitation code.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 enables secure access to event content using an invitation code, which is the authentication mechanism. llg_002 extends this by allowing the guest to view specific content types (blogs and photos) after authentication. Together, they define a complete scope: secure access via invitation code and subsequent viewing of event content — no broader or unrelated capabilities are inferred, and no child is omitted.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable invited guests to contribute content, media, and feedback to an event blog through posting, uploading, and commenting.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 enables content submission (posting blog posts or media), llg_002 enables media uploading (images or videos), and llg_003 enables interaction (commenting on posts). Together, they define a complete scope of guest participation in the event blog, including content creation, media sharing, and community engagement — no capability is generalized or omitted.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable the event organizer to review historical contract data and monitor real-time budget status for financial oversight and decision-making.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 enables the event organizer to view and manage contract history, including status, cost, and completion details, which supports retrospective analysis of past agreements. llg_002 enables the event organizer to view the remaining event budget after accounting for all booked services and expenses, which supports real-time financial monitoring. Together, these capabilities cover both historical contract review and current budget tracking, with no overlap or omission — the reconstructed goal explicitly includes both distinct functional domains without generalizing or omitting either.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable service providers to publish, categorize, and tag their service offerings on the platform for discoverability by event organizers.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 enables service providers to publish service offerings by uploading details such as description, pricing, and availability; llg_002 enables them to categorize and tag services to enhance discoverability by event organizers. Together, these capabilities form a complete scope for service publication and metadata management, with no unrelated or broader capabilities introduced.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Book selected services with payment options including one-time, installment, or on-site payment methods, and confirm the booking for the event organizer.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 specifies the capability to book selected services and select payment methods (one-time, installment, on-site), which fully defines the reconstructed goal. No other LLGs are provided, so no additional capabilities are inferred or included.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable service providers to fully lifecycle-manage their service offerings on the platform, including publishing, categorizing, updating, and deleting services.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 enables the initial publication of service offerings, llg_002 enables categorization and tagging for discoverability, llg_003 enables modification of existing offerings after publication, and llg_004 enables permanent removal of offerings — together, these cover the full lifecycle of service offerings on the platform, including creation, metadata enrichment, modification, and deletion.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable event organizers to book services with specified payment methods, track installment and on-site payments via provider confirmation, view full payment transaction history, and monitor real-time event budget depletion after payments.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 enables booking services with payment method selection; llg_002 enables provider confirmation of installment payments and status updates; llg_003 enables provider confirmation of on-site payments and status updates; llg_004 enables viewing historical payment records including status and amount; llg_005 enables real-time tracking of budget depletion after accepted payments. All capabilities are distinct and must be preserved as they represent different lifecycle phases and actors (organizer vs. provider) with different payment modalities and outcomes.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable users to log workout session data and visualize activity trends over time through graphical representations of progress metrics.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to record detailed workout session data including duration, intensity, and equipment used. llg_002 adds the capability to visualize activity trends over time using graphs and charts for metrics like calories burned, distance covered, or workout frequency. Together, they form a complete scope of logging and visualizing fitness data, with no inferred or generalized functionality beyond these two distinct capabilities.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable users to define personalized fitness goals and track their progress with real-time alerts and notifications.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 enables users to define specific, measurable fitness goals such as weight loss targets or workout frequency; llg_002 enables real-time progress tracking with alerts, which complements goal definition by providing feedback mechanisms. Together, they form a complete scope of goal-setting and monitoring without introducing any inferred or omitted functionality.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Generate and dynamically adapt personalized workout plans based on user fitness level, preferences, and performance progress.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to generate an initial personalized workout plan based on user’s fitness level, preferences, and past performance. llg_002 adds the capability to recommend workouts and adjust existing plans as the user’s fitness level improves or plateaus — indicating a dynamic, iterative adaptation capability that extends beyond static plan generation.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Onboard new users and guide them through beginner-friendly fitness activities using interactive tutorials and personalized workout suggestions.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to guide new users through core app features via interactive walkthroughs or videos, while llg_002 adds the capability to recommend low-intensity, beginner-appropriate workouts. Together, they form a complete scope of user onboarding and initial activity guidance, with no unrelated or broader capabilities introduced.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Provide a dual-mode user interface that supports both novice and expert users through distinct visual configurations and interactive controls.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to design a simplified UI for new users, focusing on minimalism and ease of navigation. llg_002 adds the capability to enable advanced customization for experienced users, including toggling views and adjusting chart granularity — which introduces a materially different user experience and control scope. Together, they define a dual-mode interface that must accommodate both user types explicitly, without merging or abstracting their distinct requirements.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable researchers to submit variant identifiers and retrieve aggregated, cross-database annotations from ClinVar, dbSNP, and gnomAD for variant interpretation and analysis.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 contributes the capability to query variant annotations from multiple genomic databases (ClinVar, dbSNP, gnomAD) and aggregate them for a single query, which defines the complete scope of the system’s functional requirement.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable clinicians to retrieve clinical significance scores for submitted variants via API, including ACMG, CADD, and REVEL scores, and support variant interpretation workflows.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 contributes the capability to retrieve clinical interpretation scores (e.g., ACMG, CADD, REVEL) for submitted variants via API. This is the only provided LLG, so the reconstructed goal must explicitly include this exact capability without adding inferred or generalized functionality. reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Register and configure a new hospital entity in the system, including metadata registration and hospital-specific operational settings configuration.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to register a new hospital entity with required metadata. llg_002 adds the capability to configure hospital-specific settings such as contact info, operating hours, and departmental structure. Together, they form a complete scope for onboarding a hospital into the system with both registration and configuration functionalities.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Hospital Manager to monitor real-time operational performance and export historical operational data for analysis and compliance.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 enables the Hospital Manager to view real-time operational metrics including patient throughput, staff availability, and resource utilization, which supports live monitoring. llg_002 enables the Hospital Manager to export historical operational data for analysis and compliance, which supports retrospective review and audit readiness. Together, they cover both real-time monitoring and historical data export without any inferred or generalized functionality.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Healthcare Staff to manage patient appointments, update medical records, and check in patients at the facility, including scheduling, documentation, and facility admission workflows.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to schedule patient appointments with specific doctors and time slots; llg_002 adds the capability to update patient medical records with diagnoses, treatments, or notes; llg_003 adds the capability to check in patients at the facility, recording arrival time and assigning rooms or queues. These three distinct functional capabilities—scheduling, record updating, and check-in—are materially different in action, object, and lifecycle phase, and must all be explicitly included in the reconstructed goal to preserve the full scope.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Patients to Search for and Receive Personalized Hospital Recommendations Based on Geographic Proximity, Specialty, and Availability
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 enables the Patient to search for hospitals by location, which establishes the geographic filtering capability. llg_002 enables the Patient to receive personalized recommendations based on proximity, specialty, and availability, which adds the decision-support and personalization layer. Together, they form a complete scope of location-based discovery and recommendation, with no unrelated or missing capabilities inferred.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Hospital Staff to onboard new patients, document clinical information, and manage check-in procedures throughout the patient lifecycle.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 enables the registration of new patients with personal and insurance details, establishing the patient’s identity in the system. llg_002 enables the creation of medical notes containing clinical data such as symptoms, diagnosis, or treatment plans, supporting longitudinal patient care documentation. llg_003 enables the management of patient check-in, including identity verification, status updates, and resource assignment, which is a distinct operational phase that occurs before or during clinical encounters. Together, these capabilities cover patient onboarding, clinical documentation, and check-in management — no capability is generalized or omitted, and the outlier (check-in) is explicitly included to expose its distinct lifecycle phase.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Logistics Staff manages medical inventory lifecycle through request initiation, blood sample tracking, and product approval decisions.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 enables initiation of inventory replenishment requests; llg_002 enables real-time tracking and status updates of blood samples including expiration and usage; llg_003 enables decision-making on product requests based on availability and clinical need. These capabilities together define a complete inventory lifecycle management scope for logistics staff, including initiation, monitoring, and approval actions.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Register and configure a new hospital entity in the system, including metadata registration and hospital-specific operational settings configuration.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to register a new hospital entity with required metadata. llg_002 adds the capability to configure hospital-specific settings such as contact info, operating hours, and departmental structure. Together, they form a complete scope for onboarding a hospital into the system with both registration and configuration functionalities.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable suppliers to register their accounts, submit product proposals with detailed specifications, and resubmit revised proposals within a defined timeframe in response to administrative feedback.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 enables supplier account registration with basic company details; llg_002 enables submission of a product proposal including SKU, description, pricing, and images; llg_003 enables resubmission of revised proposals within 5 working days after feedback, which introduces a time-bound revision workflow distinct from initial submission.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: The system enables administrators to review and assign statuses to supplier proposals, while automatically rejecting proposals that exceed their evaluation deadlines.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 enables human-driven evaluation and status assignment by administrators, which introduces an actor (administrator), an object (supplier proposal), and an action (review and assign status). llg_002 introduces an automated, rule-based rejection mechanism triggered by a time-bound condition (evaluation deadline exceeded), which adds a lifecycle phase (automatic rejection) and an outcome (proposal marked and rejected). Together, they form a dual-capability system: manual review with status assignment and automated deadline enforcement.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: The system enables administrators to configure reorder thresholds and replenishment rules, automatically updates inventory upon receipt, and triggers supplier reorder requests with a 2-working-day confirmation deadline.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability for administrators to set reorder thresholds and replenishment rules; llg_002 adds real-time inventory updates upon receipt; llg_003 adds the capability to send automatic reorder requests to predefined suppliers with a 2-working-day confirmation deadline. All three capabilities are distinct and must be preserved as they define the complete scope.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Goods-Receiving Staff scans deliveries, assigns items to store locations based on system suggestions, and flags defective items for exclusion with logged reasons.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability for staff to scan deliveries and assign items to store locations; llg_002 adds the capability to flag defective items for exclusion with logging; llg_003 adds the capability for the system to suggest store locations based on inventory needs and product category — which introduces a system-driven decision support function distinct from manual assignment.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Order Department Staff manages order completion and delivery status by initiating payment upon full delivery, updating status and adjusting inventory upon partial delivery, and ensuring supplier payment is triggered only when delivery is confirmed complete.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to confirm order completion and trigger payment to the supplier based on delivery status. llg_002 adds the capability to handle partial delivery by updating the order status and adjusting inventory accordingly. Together, they define a scope that includes both full and partial delivery handling, with payment triggered only upon full delivery, and inventory adjustment for partial delivery — no other capabilities are implied or inferred.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Customer navigates a product catalog to select items, adds them to a shopping cart, selects a payment method, and completes the checkout process to finalize an order.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 enables the customer to browse products and add selected items to a cart; llg_002 enables the customer to choose a payment method and submit the order for processing. Together, they cover the full lifecycle of a customer initiating and completing a purchase transaction, including selection, cart management, and payment finalization.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Customer-Service Agent creates, assigns, updates, and logs resolution of support tickets.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability for the agent to create a support ticket with customer details and assign it to a team member. llg_002 adds the capability for the agent to update the ticket status to reflect resolution and log the solution provided. Together, they define a complete lifecycle of ticket handling by the agent, including creation, assignment, status update, and resolution logging.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Administrator generates and exports predefined operational performance reports covering sales, inventory turnover, and customer support response metrics.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to generate sales performance reports over defined periods; llg_002 adds the capability to generate inventory turnover reports by product category; llg_003 adds the capability to generate customer support response time reports including agent performance metrics. All three are distinct, domain-specific reporting functions that must be explicitly included in the reconstructed goal to preserve their material differences.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Order Department Staff manages order lifecycle from completion to payment, handling both full and partial deliveries, updating status, adjusting inventory, and triggering payment based on delivery confirmation.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to process completed orders and trigger payment upon delivery status; llg_002 adds the capability to handle partial deliveries and update order status and inventory; llg_003 adds the capability to initiate payment upon full delivery confirmation, which is distinct from llg_001’s payment trigger based on delivery status. Together, they cover full and partial delivery scenarios, status updates, inventory adjustments, and payment triggers — no capability is generalized or omitted.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable customers to browse, select, and purchase products via multiple payment methods, while providing real-time delivery tracking and notification updates across email and mobile platforms.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 enables product browsing and cart addition; llg_002 enables checkout completion; llg_003 provides email-based order tracking; llg_004 provides mobile delivery updates upon consent; llg_005 provides delivery confirmation notifications; llg_006 enables Visa/Mastercard payments; llg_007 enables PayPal payments; llg_008 enables Satispay payments; llg_009 enables La Reine Marlene purchase card payments; llg_010 enables online bank transfer payments. All these capabilities are distinct and must be explicitly included to preserve the full scope.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Customer-Service Agent creates support tickets with customer details, assigns them to team members, updates their status to reflect resolution, and logs the solution provided.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability for the agent to create support tickets with customer details and assign them to team members. llg_002 adds the capability for the agent to update ticket status to reflect resolution and log the solution provided. Together, they define a complete lifecycle of ticket creation, assignment, resolution, and documentation.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Order Department Staff manages order completion and inventory synchronization by confirming full or partial delivery, initiating payment, and updating system status and stock levels accordingly.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to confirm order completion and trigger payment based on delivery status. llg_002 adds the capability to update order status and inventory specifically for partial delivery scenarios. Together, they define a scope that includes both full and partial delivery handling, payment initiation, and inventory adjustment — no other capability is implied or inferred.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Automatically assign, respond to, reassign, and statistically track support tickets to ensure timely customer service with performance monitoring.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 adds automatic ticket assignment to agents based on rules or availability; llg_002 adds the requirement that agents must respond within 24 hours and notify the customer; llg_003 adds automatic reassignment if no response occurs within 24 hours and logs the event; llg_004 adds the capability to update service statistics after any ticket action (reassignment or resolution), including metrics like response time and reassignment rate. Together, these form a closed-loop ticket-handling system with performance tracking, including an outlier capability (llg_004) that is not directly tied to ticket assignment or response but is essential for operational metrics.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Administrator performs data-driven operational analysis across order performance, inventory optimization, customer support efficiency, and supplier procurement optimization to drive strategic decision-making.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to generate and export order performance reports covering volume, fulfillment rates, and supplier delivery performance. llg_002 adds automated correlation of sales and inventory data to identify stock imbalances and trigger adjustment recommendations. llg_003 adds automated aggregation and visualization of support ticket resolution metrics to identify service bottlenecks and optimize agent allocation. llg_004 adds automated correlation of fulfillment and supplier data to identify underperforming suppliers and recommend procurement changes. reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Assign an available ambulance to an emergency call within 11 minutes of call receipt, ensuring timely response and resource allocation.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 specifies the core capability of assigning an available ambulance to an emergency call within 11 minutes of call receipt. This goal captures the exact functional requirement without generalization or omission, as no other LLGs are provided. The reconstructed goal preserves the strict time constraint and the specific actor (Dispatcher) and object (ambulance) without adding inferred or generalized functionality.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Log the complete operational timeline and geographic trace of each assigned ambulance from departure to arrival at the scene.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to record the departure time and location (GPS coordinates) of the ambulance, establishing the start point of its operational timeline. llg_002 adds the capability to record the destination address and arrival time, establishing the endpoint of the operational timeline. Together, they define a complete geographic and temporal trace of the ambulance’s movement, with no implicit or inferred operations beyond these two distinct logging actions.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Maintain real-time, continuous GPS-based tracking of ambulance location during active response missions, with mandatory periodic updates every 30 seconds from the driver.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 specifies that the Ambulance Driver must send GPS coordinates every 30 seconds while en route, which directly defines the requirement for real-time, periodic location updates. No other LLGs are provided, so the reconstructed goal must fully capture this singular capability without inference or generalization.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable an Emergency Caller to initiate an emergency response by dialing a phone number and simultaneously submitting incident details to a dispatch system for coordinated action.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 enables the Emergency Caller to initiate an emergency call via phone interface, which triggers logging of incident details; llg_002 enables the Emergency Caller to submit incident details (location, nature of emergency, contact info) to a dispatch system. Together, these LLGs describe a dual-action capability: initiating a call while simultaneously submitting structured incident data to a dispatch system — no other capability is implied or inferred.

Together, they form a complete scope of estimate submission and collective visualization, with no unrelated or broader capabilities introduced.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable citizens to submit urban issue reports with detailed metadata and track the lifecycle status of multiple reports they follow.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 enables citizens to initiate report submission with location, description, category, and optional media, establishing the reporting mechanism. llg_002 enables citizens to follow and monitor multiple reports for updates and resolution progress, introducing a tracking and lifecycle monitoring capability that extends beyond mere submission.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Citizen interacts with a public interactive map to view and filter reports by category, status, or location, and sort them according to specified criteria.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 enables the citizen to view a public interactive map displaying all reports with filters and location context; llg_002 adds the capability to apply filters and sorting by category or status, which extends the interaction beyond mere viewing to active refinement of the displayed data.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Citizen can view the status and receive notifications about updates for submitted reports.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 contributes the capability for citizens to view the current status of their submitted reports and receive notifications about updates; no other LLGs are provided, so the reconstructed goal encompasses only this capability.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Provide public, anonymous access to aggregated report statistics and an interactive map of report locations without requiring user authentication.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 enables non-registered users to view public statistics on report trends and categories, which implies data aggregation and visualization for public consumption. llg_002 enables non-registered users to view a public interactive map of reports, which implies spatial visualization and location-based data presentation. Together, these LLGs define a scope of public-facing, anonymous data visualization tools focused on report trends and geographic distribution — no authentication is required for either capability.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable citizen report review and decision-making with mandatory justification for rejection by organization office staff.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 introduces the capability for organization office staff to review citizen reports and make binary decisions (approve or reject) with mandatory explanation required for rejection. No other LLGs are provided, so the reconstructed goal captures only this single functional capability without adding or omitting anything.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Assign reports to appropriate departments or external companies based on report category, with technical office staff as the assigning actor.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 specifies that technical office staff assign reports to departments or external companies based on category — this is the only LLG provided, and it introduces the actor (technical office staff), the object (reports), the decision criterion (category), and the action (assign). No other LLGs are supplied, so no additional capabilities can be inferred or included.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Municipal Administrator to view both public report statistics and private system performance analytics for comprehensive oversight of report trends and system resource allocation.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 enables the Municipal Administrator to view public report statistics and trends, which supports transparency and trend analysis. llg_002 enables access to private system performance analytics, which supports internal monitoring and resource allocation decisions. Together, they cover distinct domains: public-facing data and private system metrics — no overlap or generalization is permitted, and both capabilities must be explicitly included to preserve the full scope.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Prepare and publish a municipal system as open-source software on https://developers.italia.it/, including configuring system settings for release and executing the public publication.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to configure system settings specifically for an open-source release and integration with https://developers.italia.it/. llg_002 adds the capability to publish the system as open-source on that platform. Together, they form a complete scope covering both configuration and publication, with no hidden or inferred functionality.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable citizens to submit urban issue reports with structured metadata and media, track their lifecycle states through automated transitions with mandatory rejection explanations, receive configurable notifications for updates including chatbot interactions, and follow multiple reports to monitor resolution progress dynamically.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 enables citizens to submit structured urban issue reports including mandatory fields, media, and anonymity options. llg_002 defines the automated state transitions and mandatory rejection explanations that govern report lifecycle management. llg_003 adds the capability for citizens to receive configurable notifications for state changes and staff messages, including those initiated by chatbots. llg_004 introduces the ability to follow multiple reports dynamically, allowing citizens to monitor resolution progress across multiple issues — a distinct capability that extends beyond single-report tracking.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Citizen interacts with a public interactive map and summary table to view, filter, sort, and access details of all public reports, including their own submitted and approved reports, with anonymization and geolocation controls, and also accesses reports via external chatbots with equivalent interactive and summary views.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 enables viewing public reports on an interactive map with filters; llg_002 adds filtering and sorting by category or status; llg_003 adds viewing of own reports on the map with geolocation and anonymization; llg_004 adds viewing of own reports in a summary table with anonymization; llg_005 enables accessing report details via map or table clicks; llg_006 introduces an unrelated capability: accessing reports via external chatbots with map and table views — this must be explicitly included to expose the mismatch.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable citizens to view the status and receive notifications about updates for submitted reports.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 contributes the capability for citizens to view the current status of their submitted reports and receive notifications about updates. This is the only LLG provided, so the reconstructed HLG fully captures this specific functionality without adding or omitting any element.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable citizens to submit urban issue reports with structured metadata and media, track their lifecycle states through automated transitions with mandatory rejection explanations, receive configurable notifications for updates including chatbot interactions, and follow multiple reports to monitor resolution progress dynamically.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Citizen interacts with a public interactive map and summary table to view, filter, sort, and access details of all public reports, including their own submitted and approved reports, with anonymization and geolocation controls, and also accesses reports via external chatbots with equivalent interactive and summary views.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 enables viewing public reports on an interactive map with filters; llg_002 adds filtering and sorting by category or status; llg_003 adds viewing of own reports on the map with geolocation and anonymization; llg_004 adds viewing of own reports in a summary table with anonymization; llg_005 enables accessing report details via map or table clicks; llg_006 introduces an unrelated capability: accessing reports via external chatbots with map and table views — this must be explicitly included to expose the mismatch.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Citizen-facing real-time report tracking and communication system enabling status monitoring, direct messaging with municipal staff, and cross-report following with notifications.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 enables real-time status change notifications for the citizen’s own report; llg_002 enables direct messaging between citizen and municipal staff; llg_003 enables viewing current status and associated updates; llg_004 enables following other citizens’ reports and receiving notifications about those reports — together, these form a system for real-time tracking and communication around reports, including cross-report following, which is an outlier capability not present in the others.

reconstructions.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Technical Office Staff to verify and formally record external company resolution submissions for Participium reports, including receiving notifications, manually updating report status to 'Resolved', and logging verification metadata for audit trail.
reconstructions.rationale: llg_001 enables the system to notify Technical Office Staff about external company updates, which is the trigger for verification. llg_002 allows staff to manually update the report status to 'Resolved' after verification, indicating a human-in-the-loop decision point. llg_003 ensures that each verification action is logged with metadata for auditability, which is a distinct lifecycle phase and outcome. Together, these LLGs form a complete workflow for handling external resolution submissions, including notification, manual status update, and audit logging — with no inferred or generalized functionality.
